Package pt.pa.controller

Class BaseController

java.lang.Object
pt.pa.controller.BaseController
public class BaseController extends Object
Represents the controller class of the base layout with the map, left tab menu, and bottom menu.

    • notifyCalculatedRoute

      public void notifyCalculatedRoute(com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop> originStopVertex, com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop> destinationStopVertex, List<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop>> middleStops, Collection<org.javatuples.Quartet<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Edge<Route,Stop>,String,TransportColor,Double>> pathEdges, TransportMetrics totalTransportMetrics)
      Notifies the map controller to visually update the map based on the calculated route details. Marks the origin stop, destination stop, middle stops, and the path edges on the map. This method is typically used after a route calculation is performed to display the route on the map.
      Parameters:
      originStopVertex - the vertex representing the origin stop.
      destinationStopVertex - the vertex representing the destination stop.
      middleStops - a list of vertices representing intermediate stops along the route.
      pathEdges - a collection of triplets, where each triplet contains: - The edge representing a route segment, - A color associated with that segment (for display purposes), - A double representing the segment thickness or weight.
      totalTransportMetrics - A transport metrics instance that was previously summed to become the total.

    • notifyFoundStops

      public void notifyFoundStops(com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop> originStopVertex, int distance, Collection<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop>> destinationStopVertices)
      Notifies the map and bottom menu that a collection of destination stop vertices were found.
      Parameters:
      originStopVertex - The origin stop vertex from which the destinations were calculated.
      distance - The distance from the origin stop to each destination stop.
      destinationStopVertices - The destination stop vertices found.
